attributes.value:
Context
Only an admin can add someone to a workspace, so members wait on an admin to bring a teammate in. Invites let any member do it, and expire after a week. CAd
Goal
A member invites a teammate by email.
The teammate joins the workspace by opening the link.
A withdrawn or accepted link grants nothing when it is opened again.
Approach
Model an invite as a memberships row with state = pending, so removal covers invites and members alike.
export function inviteMember(workspaceId: string, email: string): Pr
